Chapter 119: This Way, I'm Not Nervous Anymore

The gymnasium of Fuyi High was located in the southwest corner of the school.

When passing by on the road outside the school gate, the most eye-catching sights were the gymnasium and the library, situated on either side of the entrance.

The parents entered through the main south entrance of the gymnasium, which opened up to a standard indoor basketball court.

On both sides were the spectator stands.

Under Xiuxiu's guidance, the parents of Class Eight went up the stairs to the right and then chose their seats freely.

The entire gymnasium could accommodate about two thousand spectators.

For the rock club's performance this time, the stands on the left side were not open; the stands on the right side alone were enough to seat the more than six hundred parents.

Li Guohong walked up the steps and looked toward the upper part of the stands, easily spotting his wife.

At this moment, Lin Xiuhong was receiving similar treatment to Li Guohong among the Class Eight parents, surrounded by a crowd.

Fortunately, they had already chatted enough during the school tour earlier, so they were all quiet now.

After all, they were middle-aged, with limited stamina. Having wandered around the school for a while, they were tired and glad to sit down for a short rest.

Li Guohong, standing at a lower position, quickly waved to Lin Xiuhong.

Seeing Li Guohong's signal, Lin Xiuhong stood up and walked down to the lower rows.

"What's wrong?" Lin Xiuhong asked strangely. "Why did you call me over?"

"Let's sit together," Li Guohong said, pulling Lin Xiuhong's hand and sitting down on a chair here.

Yuan Wanqing, who was beside them, blinked in surprise, thinking she had seen wrong. She took a few extra glances at their held hands, still not quite processing it.

This Li Luo's father, how could he be so forward?

To just grab another child's mother's hand like that?

Perhaps noticing Yuan Wanqing's slightly odd gaze, Li Guohong quickly pulled Lin Xiuhong over to make an introduction. "This is my wife, Xiuhong. And this is the mother of Li Luo's deskmate, Yan Zhusheng."

"Hello, hello." Lin Xiuhong smiled and greeted Yuan Wanqing. "I'm Li Luo's mom."

"Hello." Yuan Wanqing's expression cleared with understanding. She sat down in the empty seat next to Li Guohong and asked curiously, "You have two children in your family?"

"No, no." Li Guohong waved his hand. "We just have a very good friend whose child also attends Fuyi High. He wasn't free to come, and our families are close, so we helped him by attending."

"I see." Yuan Wanqing nodded in understanding and didn't press further.

With that cleared up, Li Guohong turned to Lin Xiuhong and said, "Let me tell you, you really missed out on something great by not attending Li Luo's parent-teacher conference this time."

As he said this, Li Guohong was practically glowing with pride. The triumphant smile on his face seemed as if it had been bottled up for decades, finally bursting out and impossible to contain.

"What is it?" Lin Xiuhong glanced at him, amused to see the corners of his mouth nearly reaching his ears. She had a good guess what it was about but still asked, "Don't tell me Li Luo actually scored better than Xixi?"

"What kind of talk is that? No matter how amazing Li Luo is, can he compare to Xixi?" Li Guohong tutted, thinking his wife was a real killjoy. "We should compare him to himself. Guess how many places Li Luo improved by since the placement exam at the start of the semester?"

"How many?"

"Three hundred places! Did you hear that? A full three hundred places!" Li Guohong held up three fingers, sharing the news with his wife in great excitement, carefully watching her face, hoping to see a shocked expression.

But Lin Xiuhong couldn't help but laugh. "Alright, alright, I'll stop teasing you. I already found out about that boy's results during the parent-teacher conference. Isn't it just 27th in the entire school?"

"What the heck?" Li Guohong was stunned for a moment. "Your Class One parent-teacher conference also announced the results of other classes?"

"What do you know?" Lin Xiuhong shot him a look. "He was the only one from a parallel class in the top 40 this time. The Class One homeroom teacher used Li Luo as an example to give those parents a harsh lecture."

Speaking of this, Lin Xiuhong couldn't help but chuckle. "I really didn't expect that students in the honors class would also get scolded. Looking at it this way, being in a parallel class is better. The pressure isn't as high. Anyway, since Li Luo's grades are so good, being in the honors class or not doesn't really matter."

"That's true." Li Guohong nodded. Seeing that he couldn't show off with this piece of news, he had to change tactics. He pointed toward the court below and asked, "Then do you know what's about to happen here?"

"Isn't it just listening to the rock club sing?"

"Looks like you don't know this time." Li Guohong chuckled. "Didn't Xixi tell you?"

"That girl." Lin Xiuhong blinked, looked around, and said, "I don't know. After she brought us here, she disappeared immediately. I have no idea where she ran off to."

"I have a pretty good idea where Xixi went," Li Guohong said. "You have no idea, but your son is in this rock club."

"Huh?" Lin Xiuhong was taken aback, not quite processing it. "What's he doing in the rock club? Running errands?"

In Lin Xiuhong's memory, her son Li Luo had never learned a musical instrument. How could he possibly be involved with a rock club?

Regarding this point, Li Guohong was also a bit puzzled, but he still said, "That boy Li Luo is in charge of playing the guitar. I don't know when he learned it."

"What did you say?" Lin Xiuhong was a little surprised, thinking she had misheard. "That boy knows how to play the guitar?"

"I don't know either. Their class vice president told us in front of everyone. Yan Zhusheng's mother should have heard it too, right?" Li Guohong turned to Yuan Wanqing. "And her daughter Yan Zhusheng is the lead singer."

"Yes, I heard that too," Yuan Wanqing nodded gently, then glanced at the couple with a hint of surprise in her eyes.

After all, as the songwriter of "Annual Rings," Yuan Wanqing had naturally learned the details from Luo Fei after the contract was signed. She knew that Li Luo had written the song, not Yan Zhusheng.

Logically, someone who could write such a pop song might not have an advanced level of music theory, but they must have had some exposure and learning.

But judging from the reaction of Li Guohong and his wife, could it be that Li Luo had never formally studied music as a child?

With this in mind, Yuan Wanqing added, "But the guitar isn't too difficult to learn. If it's just for one or two songs, with a bit of memorizing the music and a lot of practice, it should be possible to pick it up quickly."

Hearing Yuan Wanqing speak so knowledgeably about music, Lin Xiuhong leaned over to take a closer look at her.

The next second, a look of confusion appeared on her face. She said to Yuan Wanqing, "Hey, Yan Zhusheng's mother, why do you look so familiar, like that... that... who was it again?"

With that, Lin Xiuhong nudged Li Guohong's arm and asked quickly, "Who was that person you used to like so much? The singer who was really popular back in '01."

"Yuan Wanqing, I know." Li Guohong waved his hand dismissively. "I thought Yan Zhusheng's mother looked a lot like her when we were sitting together earlier."

Li Guohong clearly hadn't paid it much mind, not believing for a second that his son's deskmate's mother could be a celebrity.

Even with Yuan Wanqing's comeback not meeting expectations, her current popularity and traffic still made her a second or third-tier singer.

She wasn't someone an ordinary person could just run into.

Especially not at his son's parent-teacher conference.

Moreover, Li Guohong had never heard any news about Yuan Wanqing getting married. How could she possibly have a daughter?

But just as Li Guohong was thinking this, Yuan Wanqing smiled faintly and introduced herself softly to the couple, "I am Yuan Wanqing. I'd appreciate it if you could please not tell anyone. I don't want Zhusheng to be disturbed."

At these words, both Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong's minds went blank.

Lin Xiuhong was alright; her mouth just fell open in surprise. She hadn't expected to meet such a big celebrity in real life, finding the experience rather surreal.

Li Guohong, however, was completely shocked, his face filled with disbelief. He turned to look at Yuan Wanqing, studying her from top to bottom, and the more he looked, the more he saw the resemblance.

"You... you really are?" Li Guohong tried hard to lower his voice, rubbing his hands together, but he couldn't hide his excitement and embarrassment.

After seeing Yuan Wanqing nod with a helpless smile, confirming it once more, Li Guohong suddenly became a bit flustered, saying awkwardly, "Oh my, what a situation."

"The moment I saw you, I thought you looked just like her, but I didn't dare to assume, in case I was wrong and it would be impolite."

"I love your new songs, especially that 'Fluttering Like a Dream.' It's sung so well!"

"Ten years apart, life and death, how to think on, fluttering like a dream, naturally hard to forget."

As he spoke, Li Guohong, to prove the purity of his fandom, even hummed a couple of lines from the chorus.

It was just that his singing was rather terrible.

"That's enough out of you." Lin Xiuhong patted her husband, half-laughing, half-exasperated. "You sing so horribly, you're ruining her song."

"Thank you for your support." Yuan Wanqing showed a rare, genuine smile, her fondness for Li Guohong's family suddenly growing quite a bit.

She felt this family was truly and endearingly genuine.

She never thought she'd run into a ten-year-old fan of hers at a parent-teacher conference.

"How are the preparations?"

In the activity room on the second floor, Xu Youyu leaned against the wall with his arms crossed, smiling as he asked the members of the rock club, "This is the first time on stage for the three of you, right? Try not to be too nervous."

"Don't worry, don't worry, I'll take good care of them." Shao Youpeng patted his chest and assured Xu Youyu, his face full of joy.

He hadn't even expected Xu Youyu to make a special trip to their break room to encourage them. It instantly filled him with motivation.

A moment later, the door to the activity room was pushed open again.

Ying Chanxi's head poked in from outside. Seeing Li Luo, she smiled and walked to his side, patting his shoulder. "Don't get so nervous you wet your pants later."

"You underestimate me," Li Luo said, rolling his eyes at her.

Meanwhile, Xie Shuchen, upon seeing Ying Chanxi enter, also perked up. "You came too? Will you be watching our performance later?"

"I will," Ying Chanxi nodded. "I came over with the parents. I'll be in the stands."

Xie Shuchen hadn't expected Ying Chanxi to be here this time. His spirits immediately soared, and his heart began to pound.

"Alright." Xu Youyu clapped his hands. "We've moved all your instruments downstairs. They've been tested and there are no issues. The parents have all arrived. You can head out now."

"Let's go then!" Niu Qingling, as the club president, took the lead, guiding the four members out.

Ying Chanxi followed behind them, calling out with a smile, "Good luck, you guys! I'm heading back to the stands."

"Good luck," Xu Youyu also said with a smile. "I'll go with Xixi."

The encouragement from their two dream girls instantly activated the souls of Xie Shuchen and Shao Youpeng. They wished they could appear on stage that very second to show their most perfect selves.

Li Luo just smiled and waved, then walked shoulder to shoulder with Yan Zhusheng toward the stage downstairs.

"Nervous?" Li Luo turned his head and asked.

Yan Zhusheng thought for a moment. She subconsciously wanted to shake her head but then immediately nodded. "Mhm, a little."

With that, she raised her hand, made a fist, and held it out toward Li Luo.

Li Luo paused, then also raised his hand into a fist and lightly tapped her small fist in mid-air.

"Mhm." Yan Zhusheng nodded in satisfaction, slowly pulling her hand back. She then used her other hand to hold her fisted hand, gently stroking it. "This way, I'm not nervous anymore."

(End of Chapter)
